subject: Observability onboarding — integration plan, dashboards & runbooks
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@cloverhealth.com>, ops-eng@cloverhealth.com
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Sep 2029 14:15:00 -0000
Subject: Observability onboarding — integration plan, dashboards & runbooks

Samir / CloverHealth team,

Thanks again for the kickoff earlier today. Attached is the SOW and a very small draft runbook we use for initial integrations. To make sure the first two weeks are productive, we propose a focused integration sprint with the following objectives: 

- Verify trace header propagation (x-request-id / x-trace) across your ingress and Redwood's proxy.
- Deliver a first-pass dashboard (error rate, p95 latency, token cost per request) and a tracing hook for the top 3 endpoints.
- Establish alert routing and escalation for P0/P1 errors into your PagerDuty service.
- Agree on an error taxonomy mapping (Redwood error codes -> Clover severity) and a runbook owner.

Proposed timeline: Week A (Sep 23–27) — tracing + access; Week B (Sep 30–Oct 4) — dashboards + alerts + runbook handoff.

Could you confirm: 
1) Who will be the technical owner on your side for SAML / API key access?
2) Are there any SOC2 / audit artifacts procurement will need up front? 

I've attached: sow-cloverhealth.pdf (commercial), runbook-v0.1.md (playbook template).

If those dates work we'll schedule three 60-minute working sessions (trace sync, dashboard pairing, runbook walk).

Ben
Ben Carter | Lead CS Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

Attachments: sow-cloverhealth.pdf, runbook-v0.1.md
From: Samir Patel <samir@cloverhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, ops-eng@cloverhealth.com
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Sep 2029 18:07:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Observability onboarding — integration plan, dashboards & runbooks

Ben — thanks, this looks sensible. A few quick notes from our side: 

- Technical owner: Olivia Chen (cc'd) will own tracing and access. She'll need API key creation and a short credential rotation window (we use 30 days for staging creds).
- Procurement requested SOC2 type II evidence and a brief data retention summary for our security review; I can share the procurement contact if you need a formal packet.
- Alerting: we prefer alerts routed to the "Clover-Platform" PagerDuty service; can you confirm Redwood can send severity as part of the webhook payload?

Forwarding to Olivia to confirm access windows and to share the internal access-matrix.

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@cloverhealth.com>, Olivia Chen <olivia@cloverhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Sep 2029 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability onboarding — integration plan, dashboards & runbooks

Samir / Olivia — great, thanks for the quick reply. A couple implementation clarifications from the CS/ops side: 

1) Tracing hooks: we'll pair with Olivia on Monday (Sep 23) to validate headers and the sampling decision. Our recommended headers are: x-request-id, x-redwood-trace, and traceparent (W3C). We'll bring a small test harness you can run in staging.

2) Dashboards: Marissa will deliver a dashboard template with the following panels: token-cost-by-route, model-p95-latency, inference-error-rate (4XX/5XX split), and cache-hit-ratio. We will include an annotations layer for rollout windows and model variant changes.

3) Error taxonomy: below is the suggested working map to start with — please flag mismatches: 
- REDWOOD_AUTH_ERROR -> auth_failure (severity: P1)
- REDWOOD_MODEL_TIMEOUT -> latency_degradation (severity: P0 if service-level)
- REDWOOD_PARSE_FAILURE -> data_validation (severity: P2)

4) Alert routing: Redwood can include a "severity" field in outbound webhooks; we need the PagerDuty service key and an escalation policy name. If procurement needs SOC2 evidence, please route that request to security@redwood.com and cc me.

Marissa — please attach the dashboard wireframe and a first-pass runbook excerpt by EOD so Samir/Olivia can review before Monday. I'll schedule the pairing sessions for Mon/Tue and send calendar invites.

Thanks — looking forward to a tight handoff.

— Tessa
Tessa Morgan | CS Ops Manager, Redwood Inference
tessa_morgan@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia@cloverhealth.com>, Samir Patel <samir@cloverhealth.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Sep 2029 18:42:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Observability onboarding — integration plan, dashboards & runbooks

Olivia / Samir — attaching the wireframe and a trimmed runbook excerpt for the items we'll cover in the sprint. Quick summary of action items: 

1) Olivia: provide PagerDuty service key and add Redwood's integration user to staging (access-matrix.xlsx).
2) Ben: send the test harness and sample trace headers (I'll pair with Ben on the trace validation session).
3) Marissa: deliver dashboard repo + Grafana JSON for initial panels by Sep 24 EOD.
4) Tessa: coordinate runbook ownership and SLA language for the SOW.

Meeting schedule (calendar invites sent): 
- Mon Sep 23 10:00–11:00 UTC: Tracing sync (Ben + Olivia + Marissa)
- Tue Sep 24 14:00–15:00 UTC: Dashboard pairing (Marissa + Olivia)
- Wed Sep 25 16:00–17:00 UTC: Alert routing & runbook signoff (Tessa + Samir)

If anything on the attachments doesn't open correctly, let me know and I'll push to the Drive link.

Best,
Marissa Cole | Product Operations, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
